method_limits: Web search + PyPI/npm HTTP status + GitHub repo search + DNS resolution only. NOT checked: USPTO/TESS and PR trademark registries, PR Departamento de Estado entity registry, WHOIS, App Store/Play Store, social handles. DNS 'no-dns' is not proof a domain is available. Candidate names are NOT externally cleared marks.

Batey-PR.github: many unrelated 'batey' repos; JuanDelPueblo/batey (archived, 2026): 'an uncomplicated hub to connect and manage all your ACP agents' - same hub/orchestration semantics
Batey-PR.notes: 'batey' is also a surname (Mark Batey holds unrelated US trademarks) and a Spanish/Taino-linked term (bateyes, ceremonial plazas)

Chanchullos-PR.notes: No software/trademark hits. Spanish 'chanchullos' = shady deals/rackets: public-facing name for a procurement-analysis tool implies wrongdoing (neutrality/defamation-perception risk; inference, not a legal finding)

Cronos-PR.pypi_npm: 'cronos' taken on both (PyPI 0.0.6, npm 0.1.0); '-pr' variants free
Cronos-PR.github: crypto-org-chain/cronos (335 stars, blockchain), HangfireIO/Cronos (cron library, 1.1k stars), several security tools named Cronos
Cronos-PR.notes: Strong existing brands; 'Cronos' also reads as cron-scheduling to developers. Consider 'Cronos' only with the '-PR' suffix and no public standalone use

Pitirre-PR.github: Pitirre-tech org with Pitirre-Gastos repo (created 2026-10-02, JavaScript, expense app)
Pitirre-PR.notes: Org-handle and a fresh same-name app exist; Pitirre is also a common Puerto Rican bird name (Gray Kingbird) and cultural term. Collides conceptually with 'pitorro' trademark results only by search noise

Borikén-PR.github: Boriken-Dev org (boriken.dev), boriken-apps org (ATH Movil SDK), borikenDEV, several small repos
Borikén-PR.notes: Widely used PR cultural name; many PR businesses use it (moneysweep data even contains a vendor 'BORIKEN PARTS AND EQUIPMENTS CORP'). Accent form needs ASCII slug 'boriken'

recommendation: Internal use of all five names is safe to proceed. Before public branding: run USPTO/PR registry and WHOIS checks; reconsider Cronos (highest collision) and Chanchullos (connotation); keep repo slugs with -pr suffix; PyPI/npm names for the -pr slugs are free.
